svg.title: ESP32 Smart Home Automation - Wiring Diagram
svg.desc: ESP32 DevKit V1 connected to four push buttons and a 4-channel relay module that switches four AC loads.
svg.text: Wiring diagram | ESP32 DevKit V1 + 4-channel relay + 4 push buttons | ESP RainMaker
5 V from VIN to relay VCC
Pin order on the drawing is simplified. Always follow the GPIO labels printed on your board. Relay module is active-LOW.
